tei:div.tei:p: (729)mgon po leg ldan gyi skong ba rgyun khyer bzhugs/ (730)

dpal chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ 'dir mgon po legs ldan gyi mchod gtor rgyun khyer ni/ gtor tshogs rnams 'bru gsum gyis brlab la yi dam gyi nga rgyal dang ldan pas/ hūm̐/ dpal chen thugs las sprul pa'i sras/ mgon pos sa bcu'i dbang phyug che/ legs ldan nag po tshogs kyi bdag ljang nag zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ dur khrod rol pa'i (731)chas kyis brgyan/ yum chen kro ti shwa rī ma/ gnod sbyin khro bo srin mo'i tshogs/ dbang mo nyer brgyad gau rī sogs/ sprul pa yang sprul 'khor dang bcas/ lang ka'i yul dang ma la ya/ ko ka thang dmar gnam lcags 'bar/ drag shul can gyi rtse mo sogs/ gar bzhugs gnas nas (732)spyan 'dren gyi/ skad cig yud la gshegs su gsol/ oṃ byur kur ma hā kā la kro dhi shwa rī nag mo ti laṃ e a ra li hring hring jaḥjaḥs ma ya tiṣṭha lhan/ mchod pa ni/ hūm̐/ 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga yis rab brgyan cing*/ ye shes lnga yi 'od zer rnam par 'phro/ dbang po drug gi yul la spyod yul 'gyed/ dri chen dri chu'i tshogs ni dba' rlabs 'khrug rakta dmar gyi rang bzhin rgya mtshor 'khyil/ māṃ sa sha yi rang bzhin (733)ri ltar spungs/ keng rus rus pa'i rang bzhin rdza ltar snyil/ dpal ldan legs ldan yab sras yum dang bcas/ gtso dang 'khor du bcas pa'i thugs dam bskang*/ me tog phreng ba la sogs rin chen dbyig mar me mun sel dri zhim spos kyi mchog bdud rtsi yon chag 'o ma kun gyi gsos/ sgrib sel bshos gtsang dam pa bdud rtsir bcas/ drang srong gsham dkar sku la mchod pa 'bul/ (734)lha mo yu ma'i sku la mchod par 'bul/ legs ldan nag po'i sku la mchod par 'bul/ lha mo dung skyong sku la mchod par 'bul/ oṃ bhur kur tsanḍa ma hā kā la badzra shrī ni e daṃ ba lingta grihṇa grihṇa swā hā/ oṃ ma hā kā la raksha du bing shrī ni jaḥ pū ja me gha spha ra ṇa arghaṃ dhu pe puṣpe a lo ke gandhe ne widya nas shabta ratna pū ja me gha sa mu tra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/

bstod cing phrin las bcol ba ni/ hūm̐/ mnyam med mthu mnga' gtum chen me (735)ltar 'bar/ ma rung 'joms mjad dgra bgegs thal bar rlog mthar byed gzhon nu 'jigs pa'i gad rgyangs can/ skal ldan dpa' bo khyod la phyag 'tshal la/ོ mgon po khyod mchod byin rlabs kyis/ phyogs dang dus ni thams cad du/ sems can legs don 'byor pa la/ dgra bgegs rnam pa kun med shog rta dang ba lang nor dang 'bru/ bu tsha pha ma gnyen bshes rnams/ dge zhing tshe ring (736)nad med par/ thams cad 'byor par ldan par mjod/ 'gro ba nyes med bde gyur cing*/ nad dang mu ge kun bral nas/ rgyal po dge zhing des pa rnams/ chos kyi rgyal srid bskyang bar shog bde bar gshegs pa'i bstan pa 'di/ phyogs bcu kun tu rgyas pa dang*/ myur du sems can thams cad kyang*/ chos kyi snod du 'gyur bar shog dge ba sems can la bsngo zhing*/ mgon po khyed mchod byin rlabs kyis/ bdag (737)(738)cag 'khor dang bcas pa rnams/ longs spyod rnam gnyis rdzogs par smon/ bdag cag byang chub mchog thob nas/ khyod dang mi 'bral 'grogs par shog ces pa'ang gra tshang gi rgyun 'don stabs bde zhig dgos zhes mjod pa 'od zer gzhan phan gyis bskul ba'i ro rig 'jin 'jigs med gling pas so/// /
